concerns.text: T022 expects `data/results/metrics_raw.csv` from the thin 100‑sample pipeline, but no task produces that file for the thin run; the only producer is T005, which operates on the full‑scale pipeline. This creates a consumer‑before‑producer ordering violation.

Tasks tagged US2 (T005, T022) rely on artifacts generated by US1 tasks (e.g., the full pipeline in T004). According to the user‑story independence rule, each US block must be end‑to‑end testable on its own, which is not satisfied here.
Tasks under US3 (T006, T021, T007) depend on per‑sample predictions and cost metrics produced by US1 tasks (T004, T005). This violates the independently‑shippable unit requirement for the US3 story.
